name: Selleradise Elements – Elementor Addons
author: Khizar Hasan

sections.description:
Turn your website into a conversion-generating powerhouse with Selleradise Elements! Our suite of 14+ custom Elementor widgets is engineered to capture attention, showcase your products, and boost sales — all without writing a single line of code.

✨ Features

  • Multiple Hero Section Layouts
    Eye-catching carousels, split-screen, centered, and standard styles to grab attention instantly.

  • Flexible Promo Cards
    Bold, fancy, masonry, brochure, floating, and soft designs to beautifully showcase offers and products.

  • Dynamic WooCommerce Product & Category Displays
    Seamlessly integrate your store with grid, carousel, and card styles.

  • Sale Countdown Timer
    Customizable timers to create urgency, drive action, and boost conversions.

  • High-Converting Call To Action Blocks
    Default, centered, floating, and split layouts designed for maximum impact.

  • Trust‑Building Incentives
    Showcase free shipping, secure payment badges, and other trust signals to build customer confidence.

  • Engaging Features List
    Bullet, simple, and default styles for highlighting key benefits effectively.

  • Social Proof via Testimonials
    Display customer stories in card, standard, and carousel formats with star ratings.

  • Organized FAQs & Accordion Layouts
    Classic, split, and compact layouts for structured content and enhanced UX.

  • Blog Content & Tabs Widgets
    Versatile Posts & Tabs for organized, SEO-friendly content presentation.

  • Interactive Tabs & Toggles
    Enhance user engagement with dynamic tabbed content and accordions.

  • 100% Responsive & Mobile-Friendly
    Optimized for speed, performance, and SEO across all devices.

  • Seamless Elementor Integration
    Instant drag & drop setup with live editing—no coding required.

  • Translation-Ready
    Includes a .pot file in the languages folder for seamless localization.

Selleradise Widgets – Elementor Addons

🌐 Live Demo

A powerful collection of custom Elementor widgets and WooCommerce integrations designed to help you build beautiful, conversion-focused landing pages and online stores without writing a single line of code.

Widget Sections & Variations

  1. Hero Sections (4)
  2. CTA Sections (4)
  3. Product Card Sections (6)
  4. Category Card Sections (7)
  5. Countdown Sections (2)
  6. Incentive Sections (3)
  7. Before & After Section (1)
  8. Promo Card Section (1)
  9. Gallery Section (1)
  10. Post Card Section (5)
  11. FAQ Section (2)
  12. Features Section (2)
  13. Advanced Tabs Section (1)
  14. Testimonials Section (3)

Total unique widgets: 14
Total variations: 42

License

GPL-2.0+
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the free Elementor plugin.
  2. (Optional) Install WooCommerce for Product & Category widgets.
  3. Upload the selleradise-elements folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  4. Activate Selleradise Elements through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  5. Open any page in the Elementor editor and browse the “Selleradise Elements” category for all widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Elementor Pro?

Yes! Selleradise Elements integrates seamlessly with both the free and Pro versions of Elementor.

Do I need WooCommerce to power all the widgets?

No – WooCommerce is only required for Product and Category widgets. All other widgets work independently.

Can I customize widget styles?

Absolutely! Use Elementor’s intuitive style panel to fine-tune colors, typography, spacing, and beyond.

Is Selleradise Elements translation-ready?

Yes! A .pot file is included in the languages folder for effortless localization.
